description: Look up a company directory profile by its stable co_ ID. Deep adds available legal details, identifiers, industry, business description, logo, other domains, social profiles, public business contacts, founding precision and reported employees. Employee counts retain their measurement date, organization scope and measurement basis. Reported counts may be rounded. Unavailable details are omitted; source evidence stays internal. A website claim is not legal ownership proof. National registration numbers use company.

deep.description: Include the nested deep object when available. Pricing depends on the operation.
